            Hello Maria,
            Sorry |      been in touch for a while. You (1) must have been wondering what’s been happening. Well, | must
            admit I've had a pretty awful week. When | got home from work last Monday, the front door was wide open. The
            door’s very stiff, and | (2) always have got to pull it very hard to shut it. My neighbour's always saying, ‘(3) Have
            you to bang the door so hard?’ When | went in | found that the house had been burgled. They (4) must have
            climbed over the fence in the back garden. None of the windows and doors were damaged, so someone very small
            (5) must have to squeeze through the tiny window in the kitchen. | suppose | (6) must leave it open, but | didn’t
            expect anyone to be able to get in. Then they (7) must have come through the house and opened the front door
            for the others. Of course, the first thing | did was to call the police and | (8) mustn’t wait very long for them to get
            here. Fortunately, the only thing that was taken was my TV. | think the burglars (9) must be disturbed, perhaps
            when the postman came. So now (10)    to get a new lock for the front door and replace the TV, and | (11) must
            put some locks on the windows. | suppose | (12) may must get a burglar alarm, too. | must say I've never really
            wanted one, but needs must!
            Anyway, (13) I’ve to go. Hope the family is well. Jessica (14) must get ready to go back to university. And you
            (15) must be busy with the new school year just about to start. When you have time, we (16) have to get together
            for a weekend.
            All the best for now,
            Amy
